recognize_zh: 中倍下左側有一團密集的小型深染細胞核（發炎細胞聚集，可能含嗜中性球），周圍環繞淡染的壞死／纖維素樣物質與呈放射狀排列的梭形上皮樣組織球；這種中心發炎細胞聚集加外圍柵欄狀組織球的結構，符合貓抓病的星狀化膿性肉芽腫。
features: Central aggregate of small, dark, round to lobated nuclei consistent with an inflammatory cell cluster (neutrophils and lymphocytes)
Spindled to epithelioid histiocytes radiating around the inflammatory center
Peripheral pale lymphoid parenchyma; resolution limits distinction of neutrophils from lymphocytes
describe_en: Intermediate-power H&E shows a central aggregate of small dark inflammatory cells, likely including neutrophils and lymphocytes, embedded in pale eosinophilic fibrinoid and necrotic material and surrounded by spindled to epithelioid histiocytes arranged in a radiating, palisading fashion. The image resolution limits confident separation of neutrophils from lymphocytes. No atypical cells or organisms are visible on H&E. The pattern is suggestive of a suppurative granuloma (microabscess with a histiocytic rim), consistent with cat scratch disease in the appropriate clinical context.

ddx.vs: LGV forms identical stellate abscesses but involves inguinal nodes after sexual exposure and is confirmed by Chlamydia testing.
These also show suppurative granulomas and are separated by exposure history, mesenteric location (Yersinia), culture or serology.
Mycobacterial granulomas have caseous rather than neutrophil-rich centers and acid-fast bacilli.
